name: Hellfire (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School evocation [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Area 20-ft.-radius burst, 10 ft. high

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser hellfire except as above and the maximum damage is increased to 15d6.
